features.name: Valley Green Inn and Trailhead
features.description: Valley Green Inn and Trailhead is the park's best-known creekside arrival, combining a historic restaurant, direct Forbidden Drive access, limited parking and one of Wissahickon's three permanent public restrooms.

features.name: Forbidden Drive
features.description: Forbidden Drive is Wissahickon's 5.35-mile broad gravel spine, following the creek through the gorge and connecting trailheads, historic landmarks and steeper color-blazed side trails.

features.name: Devil's Pool
features.description: Devil's Pool is a natural pool at the Cresheim Creek confluence, reached only by trail and best treated as a scenic waypoint because swimming, wading, jumping and vehicle access on Livezey Lane are prohibited.
features.source_label: Friends of the Wissahickon visitor information

features.name: Thomas Mill Covered Bridge
features.description: Thomas Mill Covered Bridge is the only surviving covered bridge in the Wissahickon, a red pedestrian landmark beside Forbidden Drive reached as part of a trail outing rather than by driving across it.

details.imageAlt: Thomas Mill Covered Bridge at Wissahickon Valley Park

features.name: Fingerspan
features.description: Fingerspan is Jody Pinto's 59-foot weathering-steel sculpture and footbridge on the Orange Trail, spanning a steep ravine reached by rocky trail and WPA stone stairs.
